description: This source file implements the FaultyTensorPipeAgent class, which extends the TensorPipeAgent to simulate failures and delays in message passing for testing distributed RPC mechanisms in PyTorch. It includes methods for parsing message failure and delay configurations, sending messages with failure injection, and handling message timing delays.
